semantic_quality_checks.evidence: 72 Table 1 MIC rows recovered with endpoint, raw value, unit, target species/strain, condition, and source locator.
14 hemolysis/cytotoxicity records recovered from primary prose/SI context; exact cytotoxicity plot values were not digitized.
No database-only unsupported rows were promoted from absent evidence; granularity and missing sequence-snapshot cautions are explicit.
OA package SI PDF/text, supplementary index, archive manifest, and landed asset manifest were checked; no structured supplementary activity table was present.
Mechanism claims are phenotype_supported, inferred_mechanism, or toxicity_context only; no direct mechanism is asserted.
rwk-complete-test-0001 resolved by source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair; strict semantic and publication gates pass.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML Table 1 was converted into row-level MIC records with values, units, target species/strain, PS-80 condition, method context, and locators; hemolysis/cytotoxicity prose was retained as toxicity evidence without fabricating figure-derived exact cytotoxicity values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: Linked DBAASP MIC, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, and literature rows were reconciled against primary Table 1, sections 4-5, SI method/figure context, and article metadata. The absence of linked sequence rows remains a visible caution, not a hidden clean claim.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The previous framework-test blocker is resolved by paper-specific source review. Final status is accepted_with_cautions with publication_grade=true only because strict owner-layer evidence is now present and rework_targets is empty.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_boundary: Material packet extraction remains separately labeled as extracted-with-nonblocking-gaps; validator contract, semantic gate, and publication-grade review are not collapsed into one status.

caution_findings.note: Final status is accepted_with_cautions because linked database sequence snapshots are absent, database toxicity rows are coarser than primary exact values, and mechanism evidence is phenotype/inference only.
No linked_sequence_records were present; modified peptide identity was reviewed from paper names, structures, synthesis, and assay table context.
Primary prose supports cytotoxicity thresholds, but exact Figure S2/S3 plotted values were not digitized.
Mechanism is limited to MIC phenotype and author inference about membrane interaction; no direct mechanism claim is made.
